literal: Losing their bamboo-like fullness, the fresh bracelets slip off; having lost their companion, the shoulders have withered, losing their original beauty.
translation: As my companion has departed, my shoulders have lost their original beauty and withered; and losing their bamboo-like fullness, my bright bracelets slip off.
modern: துணைவனாகிய காதலர் பிரிந்து சென்றதால், என் தோள்கள் தம்முடைய பழைய அழகை இழந்து வாடிவிட்டன; மூங்கில் போன்ற பருத்த தன்மையை இழந்து மெலிந்ததால், என் கைகளில் உள்ள பசுமையான வளையல்களும் கழன்று விழுகின்றன.
explanation: In this verse, the heroine laments her physical decline caused by the separation from her lover. She describes her shoulders, which were once as shapely and smooth as bamboo ('பணை'), now shrinking so much that her bright bracelets ('பைந்தொடி') slip off ('சோரும்'). This physical wasting is directly linked to the departure of her companion ('துணை நீங்கி'), which has caused her shoulders to lose their natural, original beauty ('தொல்கவின்') and wither ('வாடிய தோள்').
